# README.md

Source: https://github.com/21torr/embedhelpersbundle/blob/2.x/README.md

Embed Helpers Bundle
====================

A library that helps dealing with platforms that allow embedding content (like video platforms).

> 📚 [**Read the docs**](https://21torr-docs.pages.dev/docs/php/symfony/embed-helpers/)

---

# UPGRADE.md

Source: https://github.com/21torr/embedhelpersbundle/blob/2.x/UPGRADE.md

1.x to 2.0
==========

* The `videoType` field in `VideoDetails` was removed.
* YouTube shorts are now a separate provider.
